cells.title: 练习 2：n 从 32 每次翻倍到 4096，两行「CPU ÷ GPU」怎么变
cells.code:
import contextlib, io

rows = []
for n in [32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096]:
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):  # 每个 n 只打一行
        r = hg.race(n)
    rows.append({"n": n, "cpu_ms": r.cpu.median_ms, "gpu_ms": r.gpu.median_ms, "trip_ms": r.trip.median_ms})
    print(f"n = {n:4d}：CPU ÷ GPU = {r.cpu.median_ms / r.gpu.median_ms:.3g}（数据已在显存里），"
          f"{r.cpu.median_ms / r.trip.median_ms:.3g}（算上拷进拷回）")
